body:
## Pull request overview This PR expands automated coverage for Base UI’s Combobox and Autocomplete, adding tests for a wide set of interaction and edge-case behaviors (including popup-input composition, platform quirks, and context error messaging). While the stated goal is coverage, it also includes a handful of production code adjustments in combobox internals to align behavior with the new assertions. **Changes:** - Added many new/expanded unit and integration tests across Combobox/Autocomplete parts, utilities, and context hooks. - Added targeted browser/platform behavior tests (e.g., Gecko RTL caret handling, Android composition behavior) and additional popup-input interaction scenarios. - Adjusted several combobox internals (selection handling types, item registration/indexing, trigger mouseup handling, close-query behavior, collection rendering contract) to support/reflect tested behavior. ### Reviewed changes Copilot reviewed 34 out of 34 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.
